message: Verified live revoke/delete enforcement. Fixes the v10.0.17 fail-open identity-binding regression. The client now discovers the protected core listener from the native Windows TCP owner table using the exact core PID, requires a valid /api/status Hardware/License identity before allowing a protected session, latches that identity, checks the Supabase live authority every 250 ms BEFORE local status refresh, and immediately terminates the exact protected core plus localhost app-mode browser on HTTP 403. If the authoritative local identity channel cannot be established or is lost, the session fails closed. The matching Admin verifies that the same player endpoint actually returns HTTP 403 before reporting Revoke/Delete success.
